answer: Because the timing is logged against the atlas challenge, the beacon audit can replay the gale history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 296 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3678 identities would post 3653 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
